scope: Offline semantic conversion compatibility repair; no production credentials, providers, SQL, authority, lease, fence, timeout or risk-limit changes.
findings: Eager tuple/dataclass loops propagated StopIteration and its subclasses directly where the original recursive generator produced RuntimeError('generator raised StopIteration') with original cause/context and suppressed context.

Eager converted-result lists remained reachable from exception tracebacks, delaying release of previously converted temporary objects beyond the caller's exception handler; reproduced for ordinary LookupError too.
Root reflection/prefix/fields evaluation belongs outside the child generator boundary; direct root failures retain original raw type, while nested failures receive the generator boundary.
A separate scalar helper was rejected before implementation because its nonexact fallback would add live recursion frames. Final repair restores direct literal generator recursion.
repair: Restore literal recursive generator expressions for exact tuples and dataclass fields, including expression evaluation of the dataclass prefix before fields(). Retain existing top-level exact builtin scalar/tuple dispatch. Withdraw eager tuple/dataclass child scalar-recursion bypass optimizations; do not manually emulate PEP479 or retain converted-result lists in tracebacks.
